items.text: It was nice talking to you
items.reading: ɪt wʌz ˌnaɪs ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə juː

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, look at the time. It's almost ten.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈtaɪm. ɪts ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈtɛn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is it? Wow, that was fast.
dialogue.reading: ˈɪz ɪt? ˈwaʊ, ðæt wʌz ˈfæst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'd better get going. I have an early meeting tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈbɛtər ɡɛt ˈɡoʊɪŋ. aɪ ˈhæv ən ˈɜːrli ˈmiːtɪŋ təˈmɑːroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll let you go. It was nice talking to you, Chris.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪl ˈlɛt juː ˈɡoʊ. ɪt wʌz ˈnaɪs ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə juː, ˈkrɪs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You too, Nam. Here's my business card.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈtuː, ˈnɑːm. ˈhɪrz maɪ ˈbɪznəs ˌkɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Sorry, I don't have any cards yet. Can I give you my contact details?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ˈsɑːri, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkɑːrdz ˈjɛt. kən aɪ ˈɡɪv juː maɪ ˈkɑːntækt ˌdiːteɪlz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sure. Just type your number into my phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈdʒʌst ˈtaɪp jʊr ˈnʌmbər ɪntə maɪ ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Here you are. I added my email address, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɪr juː ˈɑːr. aɪ ˈædɪd maɪ ˈiːmeɪl ˌædrɛs, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Definitely. Are you coming to the next event?
dialogue.reading: ˈdɛfənətli. ər juː ˈkʌmɪŋ tə ðə ˈnɛkst ɪˈvɛnt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I think so. See you around, Nam!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. ˈsiː juː əˈraʊnd, ˈnɑːm!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: See you around! Have a good evening.
dialogue.reading: ˈsiː juː əˈraʊnd! ˈhæv ə ˈɡʊd ˈiːvnɪŋ.
